arStrings.szText:
Every {c_random}{SF_3}{/c} seconds, a {c_important}Vengeful Spirit{/c} is Summoned for {c_random}{SF_4|1|}{/c} seconds. While active, any damage you would take is redirected to the spirit.{if:SF_2}

When {c_important}Vengeful Spirit's{/c} Life is fully depleted, it rushes up to {c_number}{SF_8}{/c} nearby enemies dealing {c_number}{SF_12}{/c} Shadow damage.{/if}
Purchased from an Altar of Witchcraft at the Tree of Whispers.
When {c_important}Vengeful Spirit's{/c} Life is fully depleted, it rushes up to {c_number}{SF_8}{/c} nearby enemies dealing {c_number}{SF_12}{/c} Shadow damage.
